2026-10-23-64.title: The chat filter keeps your choice
2026-10-23-64.body: Pick People or Projects once. The chat list stays on your choice, also after you close Madar, until you pick another one.

2026-10-23-65.title: Meeting buttons at the bottom
2026-10-23-65.body: Edit and Cancel meeting now sit at the bottom of the meeting sheet. The menu at the top is gone.

2026-10-23-66.title: Delete a cancelled meeting
2026-10-23-66.body: Open a cancelled meeting and press Delete meeting. The message offers Undo. For a series, you choose this meeting or this and the later cancelled meetings.

2026-10-23-67.title: The switch has its own row
2026-10-23-67.body: On Tasks and Meetings, the To-dos and Meetings switch now sits in its own row under the title. It has the same space as the Filter button on Projects.

scope.deleteBody: This meeting is one of a series. The second choice deletes only the later meetings that are cancelled. A meeting that is not cancelled stays.
